messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] region-failover-monitor: PROBLEM in eu-west-1 · 5xx_rate > 3% over 3m · traffic shift > 40% -> auto-failover evaluated
maya (oncall): on it. paging into the channel. pulling logs and metrics now.
maya (oncall): initial hypothesis: increased upstream 504/502 from model-serving pool, looks correlated with a deploy in eu-west earlier. checking rollout status.
lia (sre): i see the same. Canary version 203 rolled at 09:12 UTC. error rate spiked ~09:18. autoscaler is trying to add pods but LB health checks show flapping.
zack: tagging @ryan (prod-ops) — any infra changes around that time?
ryan (prod-ops): we had a kernel patch on worker nodes in eu-west queued, but it was only applied to canary nodes. I don't think it should affect LB health but will check host logs.
maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) stop further rollouts for eu-west, 2) pin routing to previous model variant, 3) pause auto-failover to avoid cascading region shifts until we assess impact. executing step 1 now.
devops-bot: rollback job started: rollback/model-serving/canary -> stable (job id: rb-9876). ETA ~2m
emma (cs): i have a customer on the phone experiencing higher latency for EU users, they're asking if it's a global issue — will update.
lia (sre): rollback completed, canary removed from service at 09:24 UTC. 5xx rate dropped from 4.7% -> 1.1% in the last 3m window. autoscaler stabilized.
maya (oncall): confirmed decreased error rate. pausing auto-failover and canceling any ongoing region DNS shift. re-opening alert to monitor for reappearance.
zack: post-mortem action items starting list: - alert noise: region-failover-monitor fired during rollback cascade. we should add a secondary gating metric so minor flaps don't trigger failover. - tuning: change failover threshold from 3% 3m -> 5% 5m for EU to reduce sensitivity during deploys. - dashboards: add a multi-region traffic-shift panel and per-model health that shows deploy version per pod to correlate faster.
ryan (prod-ops): agree. Also proposal: when a deployment is in progress mark region-failover-monitor as 'suppress' or set a temporary higher threshold via a flag. We have a small infra flag in /ops/feature-flags that could be used.
lia (sre): concrete alert change (suggested):
```
ALERT region_failover_candidate
IF sum(rate(http_errors_total{region=~"eu-.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{region=~"eu-.*"}[5m])) > 0.05
FOR 10m
AND increase(deploy_operations{job="deploy"}[10m]) == 0
```
meaning: require 5% over 10m and no recent deploys.
maya (oncall): love the 'no recent deploys' check. reduces false positives during rollouts. I'll open a Jira and assign owner.
zack: please also create a dashboard card (Grafana) called "Regional failover — correlation" with panels: per-region 5xx rate, deploy activity overlay, traffic shift %, and model variant heatmap. Link to template: https://grafana.internal/redwood/templates/regional-failover (add to infra-dashboards repo).
emma (cs): customer update: EU-facing customers seeing latency spike resolved after rollback; i'll send a note to affected accounts and flag for post-incident follow-up.
maya (oncall): handoff — i'm going offline in 20m, lia will take over monitoring and the follow-ups. @lia please confirm you have context to own the post-incident changes.
lia (sre): confirmed, I'll: 1) file alert change PR, 2) add suppression flag support to failover monitor, 3) create Grafana panels + dashboard PR, 4) schedule postmortem w/ deploy owners. ETA for all: EOD tomorrow.
ryan (prod-ops): i'll add the suppression flag in /ops/feature-flags and a small binder to flip during deploys. will coordinate with CD pipeline owners.
zack: for the incident timeline in the postmortem: root cause = canary deploy caused increased 5xxs due to a regression in request handling under certain input sizes; mitigation = rollback; follow-ups = alert tuning, dashboard, deploy gating tests.
maya (oncall): closing the emergency paging. setting incident status -> monitoring (no active failover). thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=monitoring, severity=high -> incident-id: INC-2026-345
lia (sre): quick note for runbook: add a checklist step to check 'deploy operations' metric before allowing auto-failover. will PR update.
emma (cs): thanks — scheduling customer follow-up email for tomorrow and asking for impact logs to attach.
zack: creating Jira tasks now: INFRA-1123 (alert rule PR), INFRA-1124 (grafana dashboard), INFRA-1125 (pipeline suppression flag). assigning to lia/ryan/maya.
maya (oncall): last: please review alert docs for regional thresholds. if we tune to 5% over 10m we should note the expected RPO/RTO changes. posting a short note in #product to align.
lia (sre): will do. marking this thread as reference for postmortem.
